description: Write the repository contract suite and the default-suite tests that prove FEAT-001's SQLite layer. This is plan.md item 6, design.md sections 8.1, 8.2 and 8.3 (rows for common, config, index, seed and routes), plus the [F34] empty-id lookups in C-KY-01. It adds the RepositoryHarness with sqliteHarness and makeTestClock, the 69 contract cases, the SQLite contract test entry, common.test.ts (LIKE emulation cross-checked against SQLite, timing, cursors), config/index.test.ts, repositories/index.test.ts (sqlite cases), db/seed.test.ts (SQLite counts, idempotency, assertSeedTarget), test/keySet.ts and routes/routes.test.ts, which replays the 27-step baseline against routes.baseline.json. If a case shows a SQLite deviation from the design, fix the FEAT-001 code; never weaken a case. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Create packages/backend/src/test/repositoryHarness.ts with the RepositoryHarness interface, sqliteHarness() and makeTestClock(startIso = '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z', stepMs = 1000) per design §8.1. sqliteHarness.fresh(now) = freshTestDb() + createSqliteRepositories({ now }); cleanup closes that db; setupSuite and teardownSuite are no-ops. DynamoHarness is added in FEAT-004.

Create packages/backend/src/test/repositoryContract.ts exporting defineRepositoryContract(harness). Hooks: beforeAll(setupSuite, 60_000), beforeEach repos = await harness.fresh(makeTestClock()), afterEach cleanup, afterAll teardownSuite. Implement all 69 cases of design §8.2 (C-AL-01..16, C-LG-01..06, C-MT-01..02, C-SV-01..03, C-US-01, C-AI-01..05, C-AU-01..07, C-IN-01, C-UR-01..11, C-PF-01..05, C-CH-01..10, C-KY-01, C-HL-01), each titled with its id and using only the Repositories interface. C-KY-01 also checks '' lookups (not audit.query({actor:''})). Use distinct fixture timestamps, compare relatedLogIds sorted, and use rejects.toThrow() unless a PersistenceError reason is named.

Create packages/backend/src/repositories/repositories.contract.test.ts with `describe('repository contract [sqlite]', () => defineRepositoryContract(sqliteHarness()));`. The dynamodb describe.skipIf line is added in FEAT-004.

Create packages/backend/src/repositories/common.test.ts per the §8.3 row: compileLike/likeContains (ASCII-only folding, _ = one code point incl. an astral emoji, % = any run, regex metacharacters literal). Cross-check a fixed table plus 2,000 deterministic pseudo-random pairs against better-sqlite3 `SELECT ? LIKE ?` with '%'+term+'%' on an in-memory DB. Timing: likeContains('the eerie needle seems free here, see every green tree. '.repeat(4), '%e%e%e%e%e%e%e%e%z') is false in under 50 ms. Also test compareBinary, clampPage, cursor round-trip and garbage, the three cursor schemas (audit range check, canonical timestamps, id patterns) and newTimeOrderedId strictly increasing under a frozen clock. Never use `new RegExp` or `RegExp(` in this file (AC18 gate).

Create packages/backend/src/config/index.test.ts with the fresh-config dynamic import pattern of src/integrations/index.test.ts: DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT='' gives config.db.dynamodb.endpoint === null; 'ftp://x' and 'not a url' reject with /DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT/; the default tableName is 'UrbaniApp' (delete DYNAMODB_TABLE_PREFIX in the snapshot); a bad prefix such as 'bad prefix!' rejects. Restore env and vi.resetModules() in finally.

Create packages/backend/src/repositories/index.test.ts: the default getRepositories().driver === 'sqlite'; setRepositoriesForTesting({ audit: fake }) makes getRepositories().audit === fake; resetRepositories() gives a fresh instance. The dynamodb case is added in FEAT-003.

Create packages/backend/src/db/seed.test.ts. SQLite: freshTestDb() then seed(), then counts through repositories: getRole('role-admin') and getRole('role-viewer') non-null; findByEmail(config.auth.seedAdminEmail).role === 'SUPER_ADMIN'; services.count() 4; alerts.countAll() 3; logs.query({}).total 60; metrics.query({ limit: 500 }).length 24; usage.all().length 7; integrations.all().length 4. A second seed() leaves all counts unchanged. assertSeedTarget: dynamodb without endpoint and without --allow-aws throws CliPreconditionError with the §9.3 message; --allow-aws, a set endpoint, or the sqlite driver passes. The DynamoDB block is added in FEAT-004.
Create packages/backend/src/test/keySet.ts implementing the design §14 step 1 key-set algorithm, identical to the copy in <wt>\.tmp\smoke\capture.mjs.

Create packages/backend/src/routes/routes.test.ts: supertest on createApp(); beforeAll does db = freshTestDb() and await seed(); afterAll closes db. 27 sequential its replay the capture sequence (design §14 step 1 table) carrying token, A and N. Each asserts the status and keySet(body) against routes.baseline.json[stepId]; step 02 also asserts the exact body { status: 'ready', checks: { database: 'ok' } }. Declare `let db: ReturnType<typeof freshTestDb>` with no better-sqlite3 import. Log in with config.auth.seedAdminEmail/seedAdminPassword.
Run the verification below. Fix any SQLite deviation in FEAT-001 code, never weakening a case. Commit on dpi2, e.g. `test(backend): repository contract suite, route shape and helper tests`.

NOTES FOR LATER STEPS (FEAT-004 adds the DynamoDB blocks).
- repositoryHarness.ts exports RepositoryHarness, sqliteHarness() and makeTestClock(startIso = '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z', stepMs = 1000); the first call returns startIso. DynamoHarness/dynamoHarness(endpoint) are not there yet; add them to this file.
- repositoryContract.ts registers hooks beforeAll(setupSuite, 60_000), beforeEach (fresh with a recording wrapper around makeTestClock()), afterEach(cleanup), afterAll(teardownSuite, 60_000). 'Equals the clock value' is asserted as 'is one of the clock values issued during that call' (withStamps helper), so a driver may call now() more than once per operation.
- The contract imports only the Repositories types, PersistenceError (for reason checks) and encodeCursor from repositories/common (to forge well-formed cursors in C-AU-07). Typed reasons are checked through expectReason (instanceof PersistenceError + reason).
- Data volume per case that the DynamoDB run must handle within 20 s: C-AL-12 inserts 201 alerts one by one (no evidence/actions); C-LG-01 upsertMany 201 logs; C-MT-01 upsertMany 501 metrics; C-AU-02 records 201 audit events; C-AU-07 records 201 audit events; C-AI-03 inserts 26 analyses.
- C-AL-10 asserts string comparison of from/to: with stored '...00:00:20.000Z', from='...00:00:20Z' excludes it and to='...00:00:20Z' includes it.
- C-KY-01 checks both a 2,000-character key and '' for alerts.findById, alerts.acknowledge, services.findById, aiAnalyses.findById, users.findById, logs.byAlert, users.recordLogin; findByEmail with a 2,000-character email and with ''; audit.query({ actor }) only with the 2,100-character actor.
- C-UR-04's missing-role case passes a UserRow with role_id 'role-missing' straight to toAuthUser (SQLite's FK on users.role_id prevents storing such a user).
- repositories.contract.test.ts currently holds only the [sqlite] describe; FEAT-004 appends the describe.skipIf(!endpoint) dynamodb line from design §8.1.
- seed.test.ts: the SQLite block uses freshTestDb() per test; the DynamoDB block (setRepositoriesForTesting with harness.fresh) is still to be added. routes.test.ts reads the fixture with `import baseline from './routes.baseline.json'` and types step ids as keyof typeof baseline.
- repositories/index.test.ts: the dynamodb fresh-config case is still to be added in FEAT-003.
- The MAIN workspace ' M .gitignore' observation recorded by FEAT-001 was not touched by this step.
